title: Prince Harry In Talks To Be Guest Speaker For Goldman Sachs Interview Series (Reports)
description: Could Prince Harry be inking a deal with Goldman Sachs after his step back from senior royal duties? The Duke of Sussex is reportedly in talks with the investment banking company to be a guest speaker as part of their "Talks at GS" series. The series has previously featured big names like Gwyneth Paltrow and David Beckham, as well as the bishop at Harry and Meghan Markle's own wedding, Rev. Michael Curry. Variety reporter Audrey Yap gives All Access the details on this potential new development.  » SUBSCRIBE: http://bit.ly/AHSub » Visit Our Website: http://www.AccessOnline.com/  Get More Access: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/accessonline Twitter: https://twitter.com/accessonline  Instagram: http://instagram.com/accessonline Snapchat: OfficialAccess  #AccessHollywood #Royals #PrinceHarry

asr.full_text: It's been reported that Harry is now in talks with Goldman Sachs to be a guest speaker as part of their Talks at GS series. The business model sort of unfolded. The series has featured everyone from Gwyneth Paltrow and David Beckham to Reverend Michael Curry, who married the Duke and Duchess back in May of 2018. And though Goldman Sachs speakers typically aren't paid, an ongoing deal could bring in big bucks for the prince. If you're talking about hiring a former royal, someone who brings an incredibly unique life experience to the table,. Some experts say close to $1 billion. It seems like probably the first step in them developing their financial independence. And it appears Harry's already making moves, reportedly speaking at a JPMorgan Wealth Summit in Miami earlier this month,. Where he met with local power couple Alex Rodriguez and Jennifer Lopez. From a business perspective, A-Ron and J-Lo are kind of the perfect couple to be talking to when it comes to starting those second, third chapters in a career and making a lot of money from it. Still technically working for the palace for the next couple of months, whether Harry is able to profit off current appearances is still up in the air. Reportedly, Buckingham Palace was very surprised to hear that he even spoke at the JP Morgan event, so they're being a bit opaque about it. It does sound like though we won't really know until the spring when they are not considered senior Royals anymore. Wow. In the meantime, Kate Middleton is holding down the fort over in the UK where she made a surprise visit. Hanging out with animals and kids at Bark Open Farm in Belfast. Thank you.
